measured: one frame per shot read by four readers; camera motion measured frame to frame

setups.name: Agent close-up
setups.framing: Square-on at the agent's eye height on the desk; the agent fills 50 to 87% of the height, eyes 64% down; the lead soft in an upper corner, bokeh opposite.
setups.motion: Pulls out about 4.4% a second when it moves (11% on a long shot).

setups.name: Lead, three-quarter
setups.framing: Eye level, long lens; face 40% across (45-60% depending on the side), eyes 52% down, head about 44% of the frame; the window melts to bokeh.
setups.motion: Pushes in about 3.8% a second; opens 10 of 13 reels.

setups.name: Lead, square-on
setups.framing: Eyes in the lens; face 48% across, eyes 52%, chin 73%. Comes later in a reel than the three-quarter (60% in, against 39%).

setups.name: Wide
setups.framing: In front of the desk at the lead's chin height, 3 to 5 degrees down, normal lens; eyes 37% down, desk edge about 69%; usually twice a reel, near 30% and 70%.

setups.name: Closing wide
setups.framing: The wide again, always last (12 of 13), 2.6 to 5 s.
setups.motion: Dollies back 20 to 24% in about 2.5 s.

setups.name: Over the shoulder (classroom)
setups.framing: At the lead's head height, head cropped at the right edge, the board 28 to 57% down, the agent small lower-left.

setups.name: Second agent close-up
setups.framing: The agent close-up framing on the other agent.
